fusions.name: Two Ways at Once
fusions.desc: You thrust the forked head of the staff so both tines strike at once, sending 2 jabs out to 4 tiles, spread apart. Each deals 3 damage.

fusions.name: Tines Astride
fusions.desc: You drive the fork down over an enemy within 3 tiles at or below 25% health, dealing 26 damage. It is [Pinned] for 2 seconds and left 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Split Palisade
fusions.desc: You plant the staff and a forked palisade branches out from it, a wall 5 tiles long that blocks enemies for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Other Tine Follows
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, the second tine jabs the nearest enemy within 4 tiles for 6 damage. Once every 6 seconds.
